SELECT `Zero_sort_array(collect_list(CAST(k AS STRING)), true)` AS keys FROM (SELECT * FROM double_inputs PIVOT(SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_LIST(CAST(k AS STRING))),MAX(label) AS text FOR (k) IN (CAST('-0.0' AS double) AS Zero)))
SELECT * FROM (SELECT k,label AS Label FROM double_inputs) PIVOT(MAX(Label),COUNT(*) AS n FOR (k) IN (CAST('-0.0' AS double) AS Zero))
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING),COUNT(*) AS n FROM double_inputs GROUP BY CAST(k AS STRING)
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING),COUNT(*) AS n FROM double_inputs GROUP BY ROLLUP(CAST(k AS STRING))
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING),COUNT(*) AS n FROM double_inputs GROUP BY CUBE(CAST(k AS STRING))
SELECT CAST(k AS STRING),COUNT(*) AS n FROM double_inputs GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CAST(k AS STRING)),())
SELECT COALESCE(window,'') AS r FROM (SELECT window FROM (SELECT CAST(window AS STRING) FROM VALUES (TIMESTAMP'2024-01-01 00:00:00') t(ts) GROUP BY window(ts,'1 minute')) q) result
SELECT LENGTH((SELECT window FROM (SELECT CAST(window AS STRING) FROM VALUES (TIMESTAMP'2024-01-01 00:00:00') t(ts) GROUP BY window(ts,'1 minute')) q)) AS r
SELECT LENGTH((SELECT label FROM (SELECT CAST(label AS STRING),CAST(window AS STRING) AS w FROM VALUES ('a',TIMESTAMP'2024-01-01 00:00:00') t(label,ts) GROUP BY label,window(ts,'1 minute')) q)) AS r
